definition_en: a device that stores electric charge and energy in an electric field between conductive plates
core_image: 两片金属板隔着一层绝缘膜对峙：电荷挤在两边蓄势待发
scene: 拆开的旧收音机主板暴露在台灯下，各色元件密密麻麻。A swollen capacitor had leaked and killed the radio.
sceneCN: 这里 capacitor 是「电容器」（第 1 个义项：储存电荷的元件）；句意是一只鼓包的电容器漏液，毁掉了收音机。

derivatives.zh: 同根专业名词，义为「电容（量）」
同根基础名词，义为「容量；能力」
由 capacitance 加形容词后缀构成，义为「电容的；电容性的」

senses.title: The charge-storing component
senses.definition: an electrical component of conductive plates separated by an insulator, storing charge and releasing it quickly
senses.definitionCN: 由绝缘层隔开的导电极板构成的电子元件，可储存并快速释放电荷
senses.example: The capacitor stores energy for the camera flash.
senses.exampleCN: 电容器为相机闪光灯储能。
senses.why: The device is named for what it does: it has great capacity to hold charge.
senses.whyCN: 器件因功能得名：它拥有储存电荷的巨大「容量」。

senses.title: The capacitor as circuit element
senses.definition: in circuit theory, the idealized element that opposes sudden voltage change and blocks direct current
senses.definitionCN: 电路理论中抵抗电压突变的理想化元件，可隔断直流
senses.example: Couple the two stages with a capacitor to block the DC offset.
senses.exampleCN: 用一只电容把两级电路耦合起来，隔掉直流偏置。
senses.why: Beyond the physical part, the word names the mathematical role in analysis.
senses.whyCN: 超出实物之外，这个词还指分析中对应的数学角色。

intro.en: Capacitor is a modern coinage on the Latin stem cap-, to hold, naming a device whose whole job is holding charge.
intro.cn: capacitor 是在拉丁词干 cap-（容纳）上的现代造词，命名一个专职「容纳电荷」的器件。

items.en: The root *kap- means to grasp or hold, the ancient base of have and heavy.
items.cn: 词根 *kap- 意为抓住、握有，是 have、heavy 等词的古老源头。

items.en: Latin capere meant to take or hold; capax described a thing able to hold much.
items.cn: 拉丁语 capere 意为拿取、容纳；capax 形容能装很多东西之物。

items.en: Early experimenters spoke of electrical capacity as bodies held charge; capacitance later quantified it.
items.cn: 十八世纪的实验者以「电容本领」描述物体储电；capacitance 一词后来将其定量化。

items.en: The device name capacitor, favored in American usage over condenser, spread with the electronics industry.
items.cn: 二十世纪，美式用法偏爱的 capacitor 随电子工业普及，取代了 condenser。

items.en: Today capacitors appear in everything from flash units to power grids and touchscreens.
items.cn: 如今电容器出现在闪光灯、电网到触控屏的一切设备中。

note.en: Capacitor belongs to the cap- holding family and carries one famous look-alike trap.
note.cn: capacitor 属于 cap-「容纳」词族，并带着一个著名的形近陷阱。

entries.definition: The measure of how much charge a capacitor can store per volt.
entries.definitionCN: 电容量，即电容器每伏特能储存的电荷量。

entries.definition: The amount something can hold or produce.
The component that resists current, the other basic passive part.
entries.definitionCN: 电阻器，抵抗电流的另一基本无源元件。

entries.definition: The older British name for a capacitor, still used for special types.
entries.definitionCN: 电容器旧称（英式），某些类型至今沿用。

entries.definition: A chemical energy store that releases charge slowly and steadily.
entries.definitionCN: 化学储能装置，缓慢稳定地释放电荷，与电容快速释放相对。

entries.definition: A charge-storing cell, older engineering vocabulary.
entries.definitionCN: 蓄电池；蓄能器，较老的工程用语。

entries.definition: The insulating layer between a capacitor's plates.
entries.definitionCN: 电容器极板间的绝缘介质层。

entries.definition: The component that stores energy in a magnetic field, the capacitor's dual.
entries.definitionCN: 电感器，在磁场中储能，是电容器的对偶元件。

entries.definition: A material that blocks charge flow, the middle layer's job.
entries.definitionCN: 绝缘体，阻挡电荷流动，即中间层的职责。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the hold root and the two-plate standoff.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕「容纳」词根与「两板对峙」画面的记忆钩子。

normal.en: Root core: capacitor holds charge, exactly as capacity holds amounts.
normal.cn: 词根核心：capacitor 容纳电荷，正如 capacity 容纳数量。

normal.en: Picture rule: two plates, one gap, charge pressed against both faces.
normal.cn: 画面规则：两块极板、一道缝隙，电荷紧压在两面上。

normal.en: Family row: capacity, capacitance, capacitor, capacitive climb the same stem.
normal.cn: 家族队列：capacity、capacitance、capacitor、capacitive 沿同一词干逐级而上。

normal.en: Usage split: American engineers say capacitor; British tradition long said condenser.
normal.cn: 用法分野：美国工程师说 capacitor，英国传统长期说 condenser。

normal.en: Function hook: it blocks DC but passes AC, the exam line worth memorizing.
normal.cn: 功能钩子：隔直流、通交流，是值得背下的考点句。

abstract.en: Two armies of charge glaring across a valley neither may cross, strength growing with the silence.
abstract.cn: 两军电荷隔着一条谁也过不去的峡谷对峙，沉默中力量不断积蓄。

abstract.en: A dam holding back a thin sheet of lightning, released in one blinding blink.
abstract.cn: 一道薄如蝉翼的闪电被水坝拦住，眨眼间倾泻而出。

abstract.en: A sandwich of metal, plastic, metal, thin enough to hide inside every gadget.
abstract.cn: 金属-塑料-金属的三明治，薄得能藏进任何小玩意。

examples.en: Technicians replaced every aging capacitor on the power board.
examples.cn: 技术人员更换了电源板上所有老化的电容器。

examples.en: The defibrillator's capacitor stores the charge for the life-saving jolt.
examples.cn: 除颤仪的电容器为救命的一击储存电荷。

examples.en: Touchscreens sense fingers through a grid of transparent capacitors.
examples.cn: 触控屏通过透明电容阵列感知手指。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「克拍sitter」——「可拍」的照片全靠闪光灯，闪光灯里坐着（sitter）一只储电的电容；联想两块极板面对面「坐着」存电荷，即是电容器。

root: 现代科技造词，基于拉丁词干 cap-（容纳），出自 capere（拿取、容纳），可上溯至印欧词根 *kap-（抓取）。器件义为「储存电荷之物」，与 capacity（容量）、capacitance（电容量）、capacitive（电容性的）同族。美式英语用 capacitor，英式旧称 condenser。

sensesIntro.en: From the physical part the word extends to the idealized element of circuit theory.
sensesIntro.cn: 从实物元件出发，词义延伸到电路理论中的理想化元件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two charged plates separated by an insulator, energy held on a hair trigger.
core.cn: 核心意象：被绝缘层隔开的两块带电极板，能量蓄势于毫厘之间。

branches.en: THE BENCH: physical capacitors soldered into every board.
branches.cn: 工作台：焊进每块电路板的实物电容。

branches.en: THE EQUATION: the abstract element in analysis and design.
branches.cn: 方程：分析设计中的抽象元件。

branches.en: THE TIMING: capacitors set the heartbeat of circuits.
branches.cn: 节律：电容器设定电路的心跳。

branches.en: THE POWER GRID: capacitor banks steadying voltage.
branches.cn: 电网：稳定电压的电容器组。

branches.en: THE NAMESAKE: all of it named for the simple act of holding.
branches.cn: 词源呼应：这一切都因「容纳」这一朴素动作而得名。

intro.en: Capacitor is the Latin stem capac- plus the agent noun ending -or, the thing that holds.
intro.cn: capacitor 由拉丁词干 capac- 加施动名词词尾 -or 构成，即「容纳之器」。

latinIntro.en: The cap- stem of holding powers both everyday and technical vocabulary.
latinIntro.cn: cap-「容纳」词干同时驱动日常与技术词汇。

items.exampleCN: 容纳电力（拉丁语式用例示意）。
大容器（拉丁语用例示意）。

items.meaning: a group of capacitors acting together

latinEntries.exampleCN: 场所的容量（拉丁语用例示意）。
